answer: A stake-backed identity registry makes each agent lock funds that are slashed if it misbehaves, so spawning a thousand fake identities costs a thousand stakes instead of a whisper of effort. Honest identities accumulate a verifiable history of attestations, a relic of real work no fresh sockpuppet can fake overnight. Like a meadow that only grows where roots have taken hold, reputation must be earned over time, so an attacker pays real money and real waiting for every fake voice.
